notes: ὑπέρ takes a bare touching; the gloss note 'in behalf of' does not change the ASV's single word.
Both genitive ἡμῶν tokens carry their own possessive; the first empties its article under rule 20, the second has no article to empty.
ἐπισυναγωγῆς → gathering together heads on gathering under rule 66, together being the adverbial completion of the one Greek noun.
ἀδελφοί is an anarthrous vocative with no supplied address word, so rule 89 does not arise.
